messages.subject: CPD seminar: Recent developments in exclusion and limitation clauses
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

Our next lunchtime CPD seminar, 'Exclusion and limitation clauses after the latest Court of Appeal authorities', takes place on 17 July at 12:30 in the Bishopsgate training suite (lunch provided). 1 hour CPD. Please register via the L&D portal.

Kind regards,
Learning & Development
